FN-G3DSVC2-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 422
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Jeremy Gray
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/17/2026
REVISED
House Bill 422 as introduced would decrease annual sales and use tax receipts to the Education
Trust Fund by an estimated $1,350 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on
information provided by the entity, by exempting the Greater Peace Community Development
Corporation from paying state sales and use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the following
estimated amounts annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on information provided by
the entity, if the respective local governments adopt an exemption from local sales and use tax,
pursuant to this bill:
County Funds $1,350
Municipal Funds $1,350
Total $2,700
Page 1
